name: calendar
title: Calendar
summary: Personal calendars with recurring events, invitations and RSVPs, reminders, busy time from other calendars, colleagues' free/busy, booking links (members-only or public) with race-safe bookings, and connected Google and Outlook calendars shown and edited natively.

env.name: CALENDAR_SECRET_KEY
env.doc: 32 random bytes, base64. Encrypts subscribed calendars' secret addresses and signs RSVP and booking-manage links (so every email carries a working link). Unset in development = calendar subscriptions off and links rotate per email. The development value is refused elsewhere.

env.name: CALENDAR_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS
env.doc: Let subscribed calendar addresses point at this machine or a private network (to test with a local .ics server). Refused unless APP_ENV=development.

env.name: CALENDAR_SUBSCRIPTION_INTERVAL
env.doc: How often each subscribed calendar is re-read (5m to 24h). Failures back off up to a day.

env.name: CALENDAR_SUBSCRIPTION_MAX_MB
env.doc: Largest subscribed calendar file read, in MB (1 to 50).

wire.insert: import { calendarHomeTile, calendarNav, calendarSettings, calendarZoneSync } from "./calendar/registry";

stitch: Wire video calls: implement calendar.Conferencing (Create/Update/Cancel) over your meetings feature and call calendar.SetConferencing from the stitching file (e.g. internal/api/feature_zz_stitch.go init or the calls feature's New). Honour ConferenceRequest.Audience: external = guests may join without an account; internal = members of OrgID (booking links) or the host and ParticipantIDs (events). Without it, video calls aren't offered.

Set PUBLIC_WEB_URL: booking pages (/book/<slug>), manage links (/book/manage/<token>) and guest RSVP links (/calendar/rsvp/<token>) in emails are built from it. /book/(.*) and /calendar/rsvp/<token> are wired into web/proxy.ts public paths.

Generate CALENDAR_SECRET_KEY (openssl rand -base64 32) for every non-development environment; it encrypts subscribed calendars' secret addresses and signs RSVP and manage links. Rotating it breaks links in emails already sent and makes stored subscriptions unreadable (people re-add them).

Connected platforms: with the connectors feature (2.0+) people connect Google Calendar and Outlook (capabilities calendar.google.read/write, calendar.microsoft.read/write; connectors owns the OAuth apps). For Zoom and Teams in "Video call", implement calendar.ConferenceOptions on your Conferencing (e.g. over calls.Providers) and route ConferenceRequest.Provider (calls.CreateProviderMeeting / UpdateProviderMeeting / CancelProviderMeeting).
Decide who appears in the guest picker and colleague free/busy (default: people who share an organization with you) and who may create internal booking links (default: any member of the org).
Name booking links in your product's copy (scheduling page, appointment page) and decide whether the calendar is a main nav item (default) or a Home tile only.
Mobile: add a Calendar tab if scheduling is a primary destination (default: a Home entry); booking pages themselves are web pages shared by URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL).

Hand scheduling started in other features to the calendar: open calendarNewEventLink({ title, guests, video: true }) (web dialog and mobile form, prefilled) so the event lands on calendars with invitations, RSVP and .ics; and give features that word times for people (calls invitations) each person's zone with calendar.UserZone (e.g. calls.SetUserZone); on the client, pass the settings' zone (useCalendarSettings: timezone when timezone_set) to features that show times (setCallsTimeZone) so every screen reads the same clock.
Privacy policy: subscribed calendar addresses are fetched by your server; booking emails go to addresses bookers type in. Name your mail provider.
